scope: Phase 4 gap filling — loop, market, risk, paradigm sync, knowledge
constraint: paper only, no live keys, no capital

status_legend.applied: code + tests landed in this session
status_legend.detected: a test or checker now fails/raises on it, but the behaviour is not fixed
status_legend.logged: written down with a transmutation plan; not touched in this session

gaps.gap: Anti-cheat stage asked the model whether it cheated; answer was introspection, not evidence.
gaps.impact: Every transfer claim in the 10-stage loop was unfalsifiable.
gaps.fill: Replaced with an executed ablation: run(True) vs run(False) on the same task, recorded in a hash-chained ledger with SUPPORTED/REFUTED/CONTRADICTED states.

gaps.gap: The loop was prose: TRANSFER_SUCCESS / anti_cheat_passed / AXIOM_FORGE / NOVELTY_SCORE had 0 hits in .py.
gaps.impact: Nothing executed the loop, so no result could be reproduced or refuted.
gaps.fill: Implemented the only stage that produces evidence (anti-cheat) and documented the remaining stages with input/output/failure-mode per stage.

gaps.gap: Stages 8-10 (Plugin, Skill, Phoenix) are named at line 25 and never specified.
gaps.impact: Three of ten stages cannot be built or tested.
gaps.fill: Logged as unspecified; no code invented for behaviour that has no definition.

gaps.gap: transmute.py scores on pytest wall time; baseline jitter was 21.7s and hid a real 31% append win.
gaps.impact: Near-ties are decided by noise, and real speed wins can be scored as losses.
gaps.fill: Speed claim settled by a dedicated 1000-record benchmark, and the rule (bench when jitter > effect) recorded as wishlist item 42.

gaps.gap: No checker for contradictions between published artifacts.
gaps.impact: A corrupt paper book and an unpublishable signal shipped with no alarm.
gaps.fill: Added scripts/verify_artifacts.py: read-only, exits 1 on error, 21 tests, JSON mode for CI.
gaps.test: tests/test_verify_artifacts.py — 22 passed; live run exit=1 with 5 findings

gaps.gap: latest_signal.json publishes confidence 0.0 with score 44, while signal_summary.py:135 requires 0 < confidence.
gaps.impact: Downstream consumers are told 'no information' by a file that looks like a signal.
gaps.fill: Detectable now (confidence_not_publishable) and logged as wishlist item 1. Write-path gate not yet applied — emit_signal.py is on the live publish path and would need its own regression run.

gaps.gap: A signal 18.6 days old is read as current; no TTL anywhere.
gaps.impact: Stale information is acted on as if fresh.
gaps.fill: Detected (signal_stale > 3600s) and logged as wishlist item 2.

gaps.gap: web/paper_trading_state.json holds position_size 0.0124 with position_product null and avg_entry_price 80436.84.
gaps.impact: The book cannot be sold or marked; every PnL number from it is unreliable.
gaps.fill: Detected with three invariants (position<->product<->entry) and logged as wishlist item 6; state file left untouched because repairing it would rewrite trading history.

gaps.gap: Directional signal accuracy is 45.5% over 1697 samples and nothing enforces a floor.
gaps.impact: Any sizing downstream of this channel is negative EV before costs.
gaps.fill: Measured, asserted in the checker (below_chance_floor at <52% / >=200 samples), logged as wishlist items 3 and 43. Channel not disabled automatically — that is a product decision, not a repair.

gaps.gap: No fee, spread or slippage model anywhere in the trading package.
gaps.impact: Paper results are structurally optimistic; every strategy looks viable.
gaps.fill: Logged as wishlist item 4 with the decisive test (buy then sell must lose 2*fee + spread). Not applied: the fix belongs in coinbase_paper_trader.execute_paper_trade, which needs its own transmute cycle.
gaps.evidence: barrot_agent/trading/ grep: slippage 1 file (unrelated), fee only in monetization

gaps.gap: RiskManager enforces exactly one rule: quote_size <= $25. No daily loss, drawdown, stops, concentration or cooldown.
gaps.impact: A losing day cannot be stopped, only capped per trade.
gaps.fill: Logged as wishlist items 14-19 and 45, ordered by damage. Not applied: all of them change money behaviour and need their own tests first.

gaps.gap: client_order_id is a fresh uuid per call, so a retry after a timeout can double the order.
gaps.impact: Duplicate fills on network retries.
gaps.fill: Logged as wishlist item 22 (derive the id from intent hash).

gaps.gap: Two signal ledgers disagree: data/signal_ledger.jsonl (45 lines) vs web/signal_history.jsonl (1697 records).
gaps.impact: Two truths means no auditable history.
gaps.fill: Logged as wishlist item 10 (single hash-chained ledger + reconciliation).

gaps.gap: prompt_hash exists in barrot_agent/barrot_brain.py:121 but never reaches signal artifacts.
gaps.impact: Accuracy cannot be split by prompt version, so a regression is invisible.
gaps.fill: Logged as wishlist item 33 after correcting my own first draft (which wrongly said no prompt hash existed).
